# Ring & Booked

> Ring & Booked is a done-for-you AI phone receptionist service for service businesses. The team configures call handling, appointment booking, escalation rules, and supported caller languages around each business.

## Primary page

- [Ring & Booked](https://ringandbooked.com/): Product overview, features, pricing, setup process, and frequently asked questions.

## Useful pages

- [AI Answering Service](https://ringandbooked.com/ai-answering-service): Done-for-you AI call answering for service businesses.
- [After-hours Call Answering](https://ringandbooked.com/after-hours-call-answering): Configured call handling for calls that arrive when a team is unavailable.
- [AI Appointment Booking](https://ringandbooked.com/ai-appointment-booking): How the receptionist can book eligible callers into Cal.com.
- [AI Receptionist for Service Businesses](https://ringandbooked.com/ai-receptionist-for-service-businesses): Configuration topics for service-business call handling.

## Product facts

- The service is configured and tested with each business before launch; it is not a self-serve AI agent builder.
- Ring & Booked can handle calls around the clock and can be configured to book appointments into Cal.com.
- Supported caller languages are selected, configured, and tested with the business before launch.
- The service is not an emergency-response or 911 service.

## Plans

- Starter: $89 per month, including 250 minutes.
- Growth: $189 per month, including 700 minutes.
- Additional minutes: $0.35 per minute.
- A seven-day trial begins when the configured phone service goes live. Current billing terms are shown at checkout.
